points.placeEn: Pu Village, Zichuan County, Shandong Province
points.title: 童年与少年
points.description: 蒲松龄出生于山东省淄川县一个书香门第，父亲蒲盘是当地秀才。蒲松龄自幼聪颖好学，博览群书，尤其喜爱民间故事和志怪小说。这一时期，他接受了传统的儒家教育，奠定了深厚的文学功底。然而，蒲家在明末清初的战乱中家道中落，蒲松龄的童年生活并不富裕，这使他有机会接触社会各阶层人物，为日后创作《聊斋志异》积累了丰富的生活素材。
points.descriptionEn: Pu Songling was born into a scholarly family in Pu Village, Zichuan County, Shandong Province. His father, Pan Pan, was a local scholar. From a young age, Pu was intelligent and studious, reading extensively with a particular fondness for folk tales and supernatural stories. During this period, he received traditional Confucian education, laying a solid foundation for his literary career. However, the Pu family's fortunes declined during the turmoil at the end of the Ming Dynasty and the beginning of the Qing Dynasty, giving Pu the opportunity to interact with people from all social strata and accumulating rich material for his later work 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio'.

points.title: 科举之路
points.description: 青年时期的蒲松龄前往济南府求学，准备参加科举考试。他在济南结识了许多志同道合的朋友，共同研习经史子集。1668年，蒲松龄参加童试，以优异成绩成为秀才，引起当地名士的关注。然而，此后他在乡试中屡试不第，科举之路坎坷不平。这段经历使他对科举制度的弊端有了深刻认识，也为他日后在《聊斋志异》中对科举制度的批判埋下了伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: In his youth, Pu Songling traveled to Jinan Prefecture to study and prepare for the civil service examinations. In Jinan, he met many like-minded friends with whom he studied classics and history. In 1668, Pu participated in the preliminary examination and achieved excellent results, becoming a xiucai (scholar) and attracting the attention of local renowned scholars. However, he repeatedly failed in the provincial examinations, facing a difficult path in the civil service system. This experience gave him a profound understanding of the flaws in the examination system and laid the groundwork for his later criticism of it in 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio'.

points.title: 幕僚生涯
points.description: 科举受挫后，蒲松龄离开家乡，到江苏宝应县担任幕僚，为县令孙蕙处理文书工作。这段经历使他有机会接触官场内幕，目睹了官场的腐败和黑暗。在宝应县期间，蒲松龄开始构思创作《聊斋志异》，将他在官场和民间的见闻转化为志怪故事。1679年，他完成了《聊斋志异》的初稿，这部作品融合了志怪小说、传奇故事和民间传说，成为中国古典文学中的杰作。
points.descriptionEn: After setbacks in the civil service examinations, Pu Songling left his hometown and served as a secretary in Baoying County, Jiangsu Province, helping County Magistrate Sun Hui with official documents. This position gave him insight into the inner workings of the government bureaucracy, allowing him to witness its corruption and darkness. During his time in Baoying, Pu began to conceive of 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio', transforming his observations from officialdom and folk life into supernatural stories. In 1679, he completed the first draft of this work, which blended supernatural tales, legendary stories, and folk narratives, becoming a masterpiece of classical Chinese literature.

points.placeEn: Xipu Village, Zichuan County, Shandong Province
points.title: 教书育人
points.description: 回到家乡后，蒲松龄在西铺村毕际友家担任私塾教师，长达三十余年。在此期间，他一边教书，一边继续修改和完善《聊斋志异》。毕家是当地大户，藏书丰富，这为蒲松龄的文学创作提供了良好的条件。他还利用教书之便，广泛收集民间故事和传说，不断丰富自己的创作素材。这一时期是蒲松龄文学创作的高峰期，《聊斋志异》的大部分篇章都在此期间完成并修改。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to his hometown, Pu Songling worked as a private tutor in the Bi family in Xipu Village for over thirty years. During this period, he continued to teach while revising and perfecting 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio'. The Bi family was a wealthy local household with an extensive collection of books, providing excellent conditions for Pu's literary creation. He also took advantage of his teaching position to collect folk stories and legends, continuously enriching his creative material. This period marked the peak of Pu's literary career, with most of the tales in 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio' being completed and revised during this time.

points.placeEn: Pu Village, Zichuan County, Shandong Province
points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 晚年时期的蒲松龄回到蒲家庄，继续修改《聊斋志异》并创作其他文学作品。他一生科举不顺，直到71岁时才被选拔为贡生，但未能进入仕途。蒲松龄晚年生活清贫，但他坚持文学创作，将毕生心血倾注于《聊斋志异》的完善上。1715年，蒲松龄在家中逝世，享年75岁。他去世后，《聊斋志异》手稿在亲友间流传，直到乾隆年间才正式刊印出版，成为中国文学史上的不朽经典。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Pu Songling returned to Pu Village, continuing to revise 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio' and create other literary works. Despite his unsuccessful civil service career, he was only selected as a gongsheng (tribute student) at the age of 71 but never entered officialdom. Pu lived a simple life in his later years but persisted in his literary endeavors, dedicating his life's work to perfecting 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio'. He passed away at home in 1715 at the age of 75. After his death, the manuscript of 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio' circulated among his friends and relatives until it was officially published during the Qianlong era, becoming an immortal classic in Chinese literary history.

supporter.zh: 蒲松龄被誉为中国古典短篇小说的集大成者，《聊斋志异》是中国文学史上最杰出的志怪小说集。他通过鬼狐故事巧妙地批判社会现实，揭露科举制度的弊端，表达对理想社会的向往。蒲松龄的作品具有深刻的思想内涵和精湛的艺术技巧，对后世文学创作产生了深远影响。他不仅是一位杰出的文学家，更是一位具有社会责任感的知识分子，通过文学创作传递人文关怀和社会批判精神。
supporter.en: Pu Songling is hailed as the master of classical Chinese short stories, with 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio' being the most outstanding collection of supernatural tales in Chinese literary history. Through stories of ghosts and fox spirits, he skillfully criticized social realities, exposed the flaws of the examination system, and expressed his yearning for an ideal society. Pu's works possess profound ideological content and exquisite artistic techniques, exerting far-reaching influence on later literary creation. He was not only an outstanding writer but also a socially responsible intellectual who conveyed humanistic care and critical spirit through his literary works.

critic.zh: 批评者认为蒲松龄的作品存在一定的局限性，如过度宣扬因果报应思想，带有浓厚的封建迷信色彩。他对科举制度的批判虽然深刻，但未能提出根本性的改革方案，仅停留在道德谴责层面。此外，蒲松龄作品中的人物形象有时过于脸谱化，缺乏复杂性和深度。他的创作视野也相对狭窄，主要局限于士大夫阶层的生活和思想，未能全面反映当时社会的全貌。
critic.en: Critics argue that Pu Songling's works have certain limitations, such as excessive promotion of karmic retribution and a strong feudal superstitious color. Although his criticism of the examination system was profound, he failed to propose fundamental reform measures, remaining only at the level of moral condemnation. Additionally, characters in his works are sometimes overly stereotyped, lacking complexity and depth. His creative perspective was also relatively narrow, focusing mainly on the life and thoughts of the scholar-official class, failing to comprehensively reflect the full picture of contemporary society.

objective.zh: 从历史学和流行文化视角看，蒲松龄及其作品已成为中国文化的重要符号。《聊斋志异》不仅是中国古典文学的瑰宝，也是研究明清社会文化的重要史料。在当代，蒲松龄被塑造成一位怀才不遇的文人形象，他的故事被改编成各种艺术形式，包括电影、电视剧、戏曲等。蒲松龄的创作手法和艺术风格对后世文学产生了深远影响，他的作品被翻译成多种语言，在世界范围内传播，成为中国文学走向世界的重要桥梁。
objective.en: From historical and popular cultural perspectives, Pu Songling and his works have become important symbols of Chinese culture. 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio' is not only a treasure of classical Chinese literature but also important historical material for studying Ming and Qing society and culture. In contemporary times, Pu has been portrayed as a talented but unrecognized scholar, and his stories have been adapted into various art forms, including films, TV series, and operas. Pu's creative techniques and artistic style have had a profound influence on later literature, and his works have been translated into multiple languages, spreading worldwide and serving as an important bridge for Chinese literature to reach the global stage.

self.zh: 写鬼写妖高人一等，刺贪刺虐入骨三分。
self.en: Writing about ghosts and demons is one level higher, attacking greed and cruelty goes deep to the bone.

others.zh: 蒲松龄以鬼狐为镜，照见人间百态；以笔墨为剑，刺破社会黑暗。
others.en: Pu Songling used ghosts and foxes as mirrors to reflect the myriad aspects of human society, and used his pen as a sword to pierce through the darkness of society.
